representativeClaims.summary: Both accepted Numerology readings carry 1 in the same LIFE_PATH role. NUM-D7/D8 admits this as a same-role symbolic echo; it is not a compatibility score and does not predict relationship outcome.

representativeClaims.headline: Shared present digits · 1 · 9
representativeClaims.summary: The admitted NUM-R16 structural comparison finds these digits present on both sides. REL-W4 preserves the overlap as structure only and does not invent a pair meaning or good/bad verdict.

representativeClaims.headline: Relationship Number · 9
